description: This file defines a custom initializer class PriorProbability for use in a TensorFlow Keras model, applying a prior probability to weights, likely for object detection tasks.

classes.name: PriorProbability
classes.description: A custom Keras initializer that applies a prior probability to weights, useful in object detection models.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PriorProbability with a specified probability value.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the initializer, including the probability.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Generates the initialized tensor with the prior probability applied, setting bias to -log((1 - p)/p).
